components.name: Accordion
components.behavior: Radix accordion semantics, oriented arrow navigation, trigger/content relationships, reduced motion height, preserve optional mounted form state

components.name: Alert
components.behavior: Dismissible or persistent inline concern; error uses alert and other status uses polite announcement; Banner is standing condition
acceptance: Banner link remains readable in both themes

components.name: AlertDialog
components.behavior: Safe initial focus; exact confirmText gates destructive action; Escape and Cancel close; backdrop does not close; async pending/failure must preserve safe focus

components.name: AnimatedCollapse
components.behavior: 200ms grid-row height/fade after user choice; no first-paint animation; lazy mounts once; closed content leaves keyboard and accessibility tree; open overflow never clips portals

components.name: AspectRatio
components.behavior: Reserve media ratio without intrinsic sizing shift; child overflow policy explicit
acceptance: No content clipping that conceals focus

components.name: Avatar
components.behavior: Initials or identity glyphs, no photos; 20/24/32/40 px common sizes; AvatarGroup +N overflow and Identity layout; org kind exists in reference but active repo policy forbids org avatars
acceptance: Presence paired with text when meaningful

components.name: Badge
components.behavior: Badges are labels, never buttons; live state includes word and dot; Count is attention chip with on-accent text; status cannot rely on hue
acceptance: Status words remain with color removed
Long label does not overlap nearby title

components.name: Breadcrumb
components.behavior: Ancestors link, last crumb marks current unless title follows; middle collapse expands in place; product crumbs host Switcher; long labels truncate without wrapping product bar

components.name: Button
components.behavior: One strongly emphasized lime Button per task region; default/primary/accent share the authored face, clipped lower-edge light and inward bloom without texture, shadows or lift; stable-width pending feedback; icon-only requires accessible name and tooltip; native semantics for button versus anchor. Default/sm32 aliases, explicit md36/lg40 and xs24; text controls use 14px labels.

components.name: ButtonGroup
components.behavior: Related action geometry; toolbar accessible label; split primary and dropdown; safe action before primary in footer; segmented choice belongs Tabs

components.name: Calendar
components.behavior: React DayPicker selection semantics, locale date names and native Date precision, keyboard dates and safe unavailable state

components.name: Card
components.behavior: Tint shell with inset surface; plain object header composed Item; Tile is selectable card button; shared Media; min text 160px and tile floor 208px; footer wraps

components.name: Carousel
components.behavior: Embla-backed carousel, named region/slide position and keyboard arrows; no autoplay requirement

components.name: Chart
components.behavior: Typed chart config and accessible textual data alternative; scoped tokens; zero/missing values distinct

components.name: Checkbox
components.behavior: Controlled or default checked; mixed parent click selects all; native/Radix checkbox semantics and form label wiring

components.name: Code
components.behavior: Neutral tokenized machine text; shell/env/json/yaml/js-ts/python/hcl aliases; line numbers never copied; highlight accent-wash; long unbroken tokens scroll; safe text rendering

components.name: CodeBlock
components.behavior: Framed mono label middle-truncates keeping suffix; Copy last; source copy excludes prompts/numbers; Json child copy must use same recursively redacted model as display
acceptance: JSON string and object redact equally

components.name: Collapsible
components.behavior: Radix disclosure trigger/content semantics; complement AnimatedCollapse visual utility without duplicate ownership

components.name: Combobox
components.behavior: Case-insensitive anywhere-label search; accent highlight; create named query last; removable multi chips; Backspace empty removes last chip; typed mode-specific value/callback

components.name: CommandMenu
components.behavior: mod+K toggle; grouped label-first ranking and keywords; server search callback/page id; grouped limits/searchOnly; Up/Down or CtrlN/P wrap; modEnter new-tab link; nested Escape returns then closes
acceptance: Stale search cannot replace new results

components.name: ContextMenu
components.behavior: Radix context menu, keyboard ContextMenu/ShiftF10 where host exposes it; focus return and nested dismissal

components.name: DataGrid
components.behavior: ARIA grid separate from Table; typed column headers/gutter; pointer and keyboard ranges; Enter/F2/type edit, Escape cancels, Enter/Tab commit/move; atomic cell change batches; null versus empty exact; TSV copy/paste, resize/fit; id-based state and bounded virtual rendering. rowHeight defaults to a requested32 minimum; one observed content floor drives the uniform effective cell/virtual/navigation metric.
acceptance: Copy excludes sensitive values unless explicit permission

components.name: Dialog
components.behavior: Named focused task on scrim; first field initial focus; trap and restore focus; normal Escape/backdrop close; explicit pending dismissal policy; 440px default

components.name: Drawer
components.behavior: Vaul gesture drawer within React18 stack; named modal, focus and scroll restoration; direction token geometry. DrawerBody forwards native div props/ref and owns the shared inset and bounded scroll region; arbitrary Content children remain supported.

components.name: DropdownMenu
components.behavior: Arrow keys navigate; Enter action; checkbox/radio remain open; Escape restores trigger; submenu direction; foreground-tint hover; float outside clipping container
acceptance: No raw menu copied with custom trap

components.name: EmptyState
components.behavior: Title names missing object/place; fastest next step; compact clear-filter recovery; neutral icon tile and text; no generic No data

components.name: Field
components.behavior: One control with id/label/description/error wiring; group uses semantic legend; error replaces help and marks invalid; validate blur or submit

components.name: FileTree
components.behavior: ARIA tree one tab stop; visible Up/Down, Right open/enter, Left close/parent, Home/End/typeahead; disabled folder visible/focusable with reason; selected ancestors open; 16px indent

components.name: HoverCard
components.behavior: Supplementary linked preview, keyboard/focus accessibility; no essential controls available only on hover

components.name: Icon
components.behavior: 51 source path icons at 24 grid, 1.7 stroke, currentColor; controls16/navigation18/small14; semantic label only when standalone; checks2.6

components.name: Input
components.behavior: Native text input forwarding; focus border ink+nudge; read-only lock; trailing slots 24/28/32 with 4 gap; plaintext never receives secret; SecretInput masked reveal/copy companion. Default/sm32, md36, lg40; numeric native size remains a width hint.
acceptance: Reveal absent plaintext DOM until requested

components.name: InputGroup
components.behavior: One addon per side; trailing unit and hints not instructions; joined action acts on current value; copy-only field uses Snippet; shared control geometry. Defaultsm32, md36 and lg40 hosts with 24/28/32 nested action slots.

components.name: InputOtp
components.behavior: input-otp one-time-code input with actual input semantics, paste/autofill, safe char filtering

components.name: Item
components.behavior: Box-free object layout; title truncates before metadata; main text floor160px; actions move below or remain below across states; List owns current/selected and row behavior

components.name: Json
components.behavior: Pretty JSON expandable nodes with counts, guide16px and AnimatedCollapse; recursively redact matched scalar/object/array before rendering or copy; invalid JSON plain code may not bypass requested redaction
acceptance: Malformed input with redact fails closed

components.name: Kbd
components.behavior: mod glyph follows platform; one cap per key; sequences named then; screen readers hear key names; actual app bindings only
acceptance: No empty caps for plus key

components.name: Label
components.behavior: Radix label associates exact native control id; Field remains preferred composed contract

components.name: List
components.behavior: List owns row behavior; title stretched target excludes controls; link click opens and checkbox selects; static selected row toggles; select all excludes ineligible; arrows/Home/End skip disabled while Tab reaches actions

components.name: Menubar
components.behavior: Radix desktop application menubar navigation and focus transfer; no global shortcut binding implied

components.name: MiddleTruncate
components.behavior: Binary-fit text preserving suffix; remeasure on width/font change; full text for screen reader and copy; no secret values
acceptance: Narrow floor still preserves meaningful ends

components.name: MultiSelect
components.behavior: Button listbox, immediate picks; single closes; multi remains open; UpDown/HomeEnd/typeahead and SpaceEnter; modA toggles all eligible; disabled options unchanged; stable option order and polite count. Defaults to sm32, with explicit md36.

components.name: NavigationMenu
components.behavior: Radix navigation landmark and menu/link distinction; pointer/focus panels; no application route migration

components.name: Pagination
components.behavior: Total/range left, controls right; numbered gaps, ink current square; compact PageNofM; load-more live count; controlled/default page

components.name: Popover
components.behavior: Small task with own Save; Escape/outside closes without save; focus restored; collision-aware and scoped portal; discard semantics owner-controlled

components.name: Progress
components.behavior: Real counts preferred;6px track; auto warn80%,bad100%; over-limit text; known current sequence uses hatched steps

components.name: RadioGroup
components.behavior: Radix mutually exclusive selection and native form semantics

components.name: Resizable
components.behavior: react-resizable-panels typed v4Group/Panel/Separator API; pointer/keyboard resize and bounds

components.name: ScrollArea
components.behavior: Radix scrolling content without concealing keyboard focus; no duplicated scroll containers

components.name: Select
components.behavior: Short one-value list; keyboard listbox and chosen check; updown trigger; group headings; options retain separate label/description/check lanes; default/sm32 aliases, md36 and lg40

components.name: SensitiveEditor
components.behavior: SensitiveEditor defers value retrieval; SecretInput displays plaintext already held by the host. Owner controls permission, fetch and persistence; foundation owns explicit reveal/copy intent, scoped plaintext lifetime, editing/focus and status. No plaintext in DOM, title, aria, diagnostics, fixture files or generic grid clipboard before explicit permitted reveal. Preserve bytes including whitespace/newlines; Escape cancels; async failure retains draft only under current authorized editor lifetime. No authorization claims from masking. CopyButton supports size sm/md/lg host32/36/40 to action24/28/32, defaultsm, and iconOnly defaultfalse with a retained accessible label.
acceptance: Initial masked DOM/a11y/title contains no plaintext
Reveal only after explicit authorized owner success
Race result cannot reveal a different secret
Multiline whitespace and large value preserved
Grid selection/copy cannot bypass sensitive-cell policy

components.name: Separator
components.behavior: 1px rule or labelled time break; semantic orientation unless decorative; do not double header border

components.name: Sheet
components.behavior: 440px right detail/edit overlay; list remains visible; own scrolling body; danger entry left/safe+save right; trap/restore and named dialog. SheetBody forwards native div props/ref and owns the shared inset and bounded scroll region; arbitrary Content children remain supported.

components.name: Skeleton
components.behavior: Reserve known layout with soft pulse; hide skeleton itself, label busy region; delay about300ms

components.name: Slider
components.behavior: Radix slider with labelled individual thumbs, value constraints, keyboard increment and page/HomeEnd

components.name: Snippet
components.behavior: Read-only one-line mono field; prompt excluded copy; ellipsis unfocused, caret scroll focused; clipboard success only after resolved write; no secret values. Defaultsm32 and explicit md36 with 24/28 nested copy actions.

components.name: Spinner
components.behavior: Infinity pixel mark, currentColor inline and mark base/page; two pixels1.2s,mark1.6/2.4s; page assembles once; label adds visible text in one polite status; page may add a description; delay holds the indicator back
acceptance: One status announcement, none from a decorative mark
Reduced motion full mark/two equal pixels

components.name: Switch
components.behavior: Instant setting, not submit checkbox; on ink track/lime knob light, lime track/black knob dark; native/Radix switch semantics; no Save with instant switch
acceptance: Async owner pending/failure recovery retains state

components.name: Table
components.behavior: Semantic table of objects, not grid; fit columns min64, capped values recoverable; one growing track;48px rows; actions last32px pinned; stable row ids; controlled sorting/selection; virtual fixed columns; append loading and counts. rowHeight defaults to a requested48 minimum; observed enlarged content raises one uniform effective row/slice/spacer metric.

components.name: Tabs
components.behavior: One sliding indicator200ms; reserve selected label width; firstpaint/resize/fontload/reducedmotion jump; edge fades only hiding tabs; wheel scroll releases at edge; automatic panels follow arrow focus

components.name: Textarea
components.behavior: Native multiline control with Field wiring and correct textarea ref, separate from Input shortcut

components.name: Toast
components.behavior: Bottom-right newest bottom; theme toast colors; loading no dismiss; errors persist; success about5sec; action accent-fg not yellow text light; polite/alert semantics
acceptance: Loading changes status without losing action

components.name: Toggle
components.behavior: Radix toggle is aria-pressed action, not Tabs or Checkbox replacement. Default/sm32 aliases, md36 and lg40.

components.name: ToggleGroup
components.behavior: Radix pressed-choice group semantics; use Tabs for peer panels. Shared Toggle size API supports default/sm32 aliases, md36 and lg40.

components.name: Tooltip
components.behavior: Hover300ms/focus immediate; noninteractive label; portal avoids clipping and flips; one focusable child; disabled reason outside disabled trigger
